Numeric carries a target, a unit and a direction. Boolean
Numeric takes the value reached. Boolean takes done
and not done. A note is optional either way.
An archived goal is frozen, its measures and their

Every form on this surface drafts as it is filled in, so
leaving it half-finished, a crash and a restart all cost
nothing. The draft is one-way: nothing waits for it to be
kept. Whichever write commits the form discards it.

The check-in history goes unasked. The projects are a
cascade the user approves or abandons.
The history is append-only, so a date that already carries
a check-in takes another and each is its own data point.
A check-in records a data point and infers no status.
The goals overview carries no measures, so this is
where they are read. An archived goal is reported as
such, and nothing here can change while it is.
